mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline over 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS decline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations, which cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 index), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: In the regime of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 95.0), the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS growth over 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,150,000 units (1150.0 in thousands), it signals a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced construction activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST < 1150.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a central bank's response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising CPIAUCSL and declining FEDFUNDS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (indicated by GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate continued corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
